_comment: Casi di «applica stile» per i simboli di libreria: li verificano sws-editor/tests/stileSimboli.test.ts e sws-core/src/stile_simboli.rs. Piano: docs/plans/2026-10-14-motore-simboli-lib.md.

casi.nome: senza modifiche: lo stile del disegno lascia il testo identico
casi.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="x-metal-v" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <rect id="x-g1" x="1" y="1" width="8" height="4"/>
    <circle id="x-g2" cx="10" cy="10" r="6"/>
  </defs>
  <g id="layer-0" data-layer="static" stroke="#1c2329" stroke-width="1" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <use href="#x-g1" fill="#9aa5af" data-mat="steel"/>
    <use href="#x-g1" fill="url(#x-metal-v)" stroke="none" opacity="1" data-shade="metal-v"/>
    <path d="M0 0 L5 5" fill="none" stroke="#7f9fc6" data-mat-stroke="pv-grid" stroke-width="0.7"/>
    <rect x="2" y="2" width="3" height="3" fill="#fff" fill-opacity="0.18" stroke="none" opacity="1" data-shade="highlight"/>
  </g>
  <g id="body" data-layer="part" data-mat="body-pump" fill="#2f6fa8" stroke="#1c2329" stroke-width="1" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <use href="#x-g2"/>
    <use href="#x-g2" fill="url(#x-metal-v)" stroke="none" opacity="1" data-shade="paint-r"/>
  </g>
</svg>
